reasons.Bid Bond Requirement: Page 9 refers generally to bid-bond requirements only if noted elsewhere; no specific bid bond or security requirement is stated in the solicitation.
reasons.Delivery Date: Page 8 asks vendors how quickly they can ship after a purchase order, and Addendum 1 says delivery schedules will be coordinated after award; no fixed delivery date is specified.
reasons.Payment Terms: No buyer payment terms are stated in the reviewed bid documents; subcontractor payment references are not bidder payment terms.
reasons.MFG for Registration: The solicitation allows current OEM models and resellers but does not require one manufacturer to be registered.
reasons.Model_no: The solicitation specifies minimum tiers and allows vendors to propose models; it does not prescribe model numbers.
reasons.Part_no: The solicitation does not prescribe product part numbers.

field_notes.Due Date: Addendum 2 controls. The secondary bid page lists 3:00 PM EDT; retain the addendum's printed 2:00 PM CST without converting or guessing.
field_notes.Contract or Cooperative to Use: The cited EPCNT rider is optional. The solicitation also identifies CTPA on page 20; participation there is optional and requires mutual agreement.
field_notes.Any Additional Documentation Required: The reseller certifications and credit application are conditional. Addendum 1 and Addendum 2 refer to required acknowledgment copies. Contract_Affidavit was not identified as a proposal-submission requirement.

reasons.Term of Bid: The 90-day clause on page 2 is proposal validity after the due date, not the duration of the resulting contract; no contract duration is specified.
reasons.Pre Bid Meeting: No pre-bid meeting is listed in the PORFP or bid-page details.
reasons.Installation: The PORFP specifies products, delivery, and warranty but no installation service.
reasons.Bid Bond Requirement: No bid bond or bid security requirement is stated in the PORFP.

field_notes.Bid Number: E20P4600040 is the PORFP Number; BPM044557 is the separate eMMA Project Number.
field_notes.Due Date: The PORFP states the date only; the BidNet solicitation details state the time and EDT timezone.
field_notes.Any Additional Documentation Required: Contract_Affidavit.pdf is present in the source folder, but the reviewed PORFP does not state that it is required with the proposal.
field_notes.Part_no: The 29 explicitly headed SKUs on page 1 and the nine continuation codes on page 2 are listed in the Dell specification quote and cited to their physical page segments.
